s00-01-grave-a39543.wav.text: A pit full of hungry lions.

s00-02-story-98654d.wav.text: A stone rolled over the top.

s00-03-story-a999c8.wav.text: And an old man inside, thrown there for praying.

s00-04-talk-393c15.wav.text: Most people remember Daniel as a brave young hero, staring down lions.

s00-05-pivot-83eed7.wav.text: But the real story is quieter than that.

s01-01-story-05b152.wav.text: Daniel was an old man by now.

s01-02-story-c55931.wav.text: He had been taken from Jerusalem as a boy, and had served the kings of Babylon all his life.

s01-03-story-5962bf.wav.text: Now the new king, Darius, wanted to put him in charge of the whole kingdom.

s01-04-grave-4ff5af.wav.text: Daniel became distinguished above all the other high officials and satraps,

s01-05-grave-5d66c5.wav.text: because an excellent spirit was in him.

s02-02-story-a451ba.wav.text: They tried to find something wrong with him.

s02-03-grave-4b698a.wav.text: They could find no ground for complaint or any fault, because he was faithful.

s02-05-story-8311c9.wav.text: They told the king to make a law: for thirty days, no one could pray to any god or man except the king.

s02-06-story-70c3ce.wav.text: Anyone who did would be thrown to the lions.

s02-07-story-ea751c.wav.text: The king liked the sound of that, and he signed it.

s03-02-story-f2746b.wav.text: And he went home, upstairs, to his room with the windows open toward Jerusalem.

s03-03-grave-dd5d07.wav.text: He got down on his knees three times a day and prayed and gave thanks before his God,

s04-01-story-acf5b9.wav.text: The officials caught him praying, and ran to the king.

s04-02-story-f8e6a6.wav.text: The king was upset. He tried until sunset to save Daniel.

s04-03-story-c00645.wav.text: But even the king couldn't change his own law.

s04-04-story-27ac55.wav.text: So Daniel was thrown into the den.

s04-05-story-994558.wav.text: And the king called down to him.

s04-06-grave-b54016.wav.text: May your God, whom you serve continually, deliver you!

s05-01-pivot-115157.wav.text: That night, the king couldn't eat.

s05-03-story-5dd802.wav.text: At dawn, he ran to the den, and called out.

s05-04-story-0e22e5.wav.text: Daniel, is your God able to save you?

s05-05-story-ea06d6.wav.text: And from the dark, Daniel answered.

s05-06-grave-74648a.wav.text: My God sent his angel and shut the lions' mouths, and they have not harmed me.

s06-02-grave-5a0c48.wav.text: No kind of harm was found on him, because he had trusted in his God.

s07-01-story-ecb2c3.wav.text: Then King Darius wrote to every nation in his empire, telling them to honour Daniel's God.

s07-02-grave-1d2666.wav.text: For he is the living God, enduring forever; his kingdom shall never be destroyed.

s07-03-talk-9e43d8.wav.text: Daniel didn't become brave in one night.

s07-04-story-2d76cd.wav.text: He just kept praying, the way he always had.

s07-05-story-320d1a.wav.text: And when the lions came, God was already there.
